Hello! 

Welcome to my portfolio. My name is Alejandro Tellez and I'm a current sophomore engineer at Harvey Mudd College! I'm interested in mechaical engineering, with an emphasis in manufacturing and design. At HMC, I serve as shop proctor at HMC's Machine shop, a member of SHPE, and a Residential A Liasion (RAL). I enjoy going on hikes and playing soccer with friends on my freetime.
